statement: A byte-for-byte retail Wii Remote SDP HIDDescriptorList/report descriptor with model revision, source provenance and full byte hash has not been established by this independent-emulator source review. PR16's synthetic functional descriptor is not a retail capture. A redacted reference SDP record or independently verified firmware descriptor extraction would settle the exact retail descriptor.

applicability.revision: Launch, early Plus and TR models not measured
applicability.scope: Retail SDP/HID descriptor byte provenance; distinguish Wii Remote family model and L2CAP consumer requirements from synthetic report-length declarations.
